gen-gf-unkempt-clash-grotesk: Loud, loose and a bit rumpled up top. Unkempt flaunts a hand-made swagger in its headings, while Clash Grotesk keeps its strokes smooth and uniform, with no thick-and-thin modulation, for the paragraphs.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-alpino: Unkempt draws its t with crossbar and stem in matching weight. Alpino sits underneath as a cozy, casual sans, its tall lowercase making the ascenders look short, which gives the pair a relaxed, lived-in warmth.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-familjen-grotesk: Unkempt gives its o the same thickness on the sides as across the top, a blunt and commanding look. Familjen Grotesk is lively underneath, and sized a touch smaller it will sit comfortably.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-hind: Rough, brash and impossible to ignore, Unkempt keeps its t crossbar and stem matching in weight and its c clearly open. Big, short lines are where it earns its keep.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-nunito: Expressive from the first letter, Unkempt leads here. Nunito, a plain sans with big round bowls and terminals finishing clear of the stem, can be nudged up a size so its friendly shapes are easy to read.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Commanding and a little rough, Unkempt makes its c open up so it never gets mistaken for an o. Pilcrow Rounded follows with tight letter spacing and big counters in a tall lowercase, and Unkempt does its best work large and brief.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-quicksand: Expressive and slightly scruffy, Unkempt gives headings a hand-hewn punch, especially when they are big and brief. Quicksand then brings tall, round lowercase bowls in lines of uniform thickness, a gentle sans-serif counterpart.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-actor: Commanding and hand-cut, Unkempt has no thin hairline anywhere, just thick stems. Actor does its own work below as a modern sans, with wide s curves that barely curl in.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-akatab: Strokes like bent plastic tubing give Unkempt its odd, springy look, with the t crossbar matching its stem. Akatab's cupped round letters then settle the page.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-alan-sans: Unkempt is expressive and commanding, with no pressure swells where the eye slows down, while Alan Sans holds its curve tails well back from the body. Rough meets tidy, and that gap is the point.
